name: VPN Gateway
description: A VPN gateway — also called a remote-access concentrator, IPsec/SSL VPN, WireGuard/OpenVPN endpoint, or tunnel terminator — that terminates encrypted remote-access tunnels and admits external users into internal zones. A bridge between untrusted and trusted networks. The place to look for the VPN gateway, remote-access VPN, tunnel endpoint, or the device admitting remote users into the internal network.
